description: Went out to Portland, OR early October 2022 and linked with the 1 and only goldenbeets following a blistering and bruising Summer in Chicago. When we weren't making music, we were eating and drinking our way around the city, linking up with some wonderful people and artists along the way. A collaboration that did much good for my soul and I believe the music reflects this! We hope you enjoy thoroughly.
credits:
Words unless otherwise noted by Rich Jones
Sounds by goldenbeets
Additional saxophone and flute by Eric Novak on "The Sting"
